name: Nordic Villa (北欧别墅)
use_for: modern-looking houses, villas, clean minimalist builds with big windows and flat roofs

materials.primary_use: main wall planes, kept in large clean surfaces
materials.secondary_use: one accent wall plane or entrance surround per facade (wood warmth against white)
materials.accent_use: roof coping, window surrounds, base plinth trim

roof.material: smooth_stone_slab walking surface + dark coping band (dark_oak or smooth_stone) around the edge, ALWAYS one shade darker than walls
roof.coping: 1-block-wide dark band at roof perimeter; optional stepped parapet

windows.pattern: large horizontal bands: floor-to-ceiling 2-3 high, 3-6 wide, grouped on the best-view facade; corner windows where two bands meet

details.base: smooth_stone or stone 1-block plinth at ground contact; recessed entry
details.floor: birch_planks interior floors (light wood is the nordic signature)
details.lighting: minecraft:lantern or hidden minecraft:glowstone under slab edges; sparse and warm
details.terrace: birch or spruce slab terrace with dark_oak fence-less edge, 1-2 steps of smooth_stone to lawn
details.planting: short grass, flowers, one birch or spruce near the corner — landscaping is part of the style

pilaster.note: clean planes are the point — depth comes from the wood accent wall and window bands, not piers

string_course.note: the dark roof coping band is the only horizontal accent
